title: Identify the city and full street address of the exclusively virtual charte
question: Identify the city and full street address of the exclusively virtual charter school in California that is directly funded, opened after January 1, 2010, and has the lowest latitude among all such schools. Also report its lowest grade offered.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_050, s.XCL_048, s.XCL_074
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
WHERE s.XCL_076 = 'F'
  AND s.XCL_063 = 1
  AND s.XCL_052 = 'CA'
  AND f.XCL_015 = 'Directly funded'
  AND s.XCL_061 > '2010-01-01'
ORDER BY s.XCL_078 ASC
LIMIT 1
